answer.evidence: radon/metrics.py:150-157 defines mi_rank(score): docstring says A if score > 19, B if 9 < score <= 19, C if score <= 9. Implementation is chr(65 + (9 - score >= 0) + (19 - score >= 0)), so the boundaries 9 and 19 fall into the lower grade (inclusive). radon/complexity.py only has cc_rank (A-F, divided by 10), a different mapping, so it is a secondary comparison. radon/raw.py and radon/visitors.py contain no rank mapping. I did not read the handoff_refs files.
